summary.text: Sarah Fowler Arthur has served in the Ohio House since January 2021, representing District 99, and chairs the House Education Committee. She is an entrepreneur who was previously elected to the State Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Fowler Arthur was the first homeschool graduate in the nation elected to a State Board of Education, serving Ohio from 2013 to 2020 after her first election in 2012 at age 23.
She grew up working on her family farm and began her first business at age 11, Sarah's Eggs, later teaching piano for five years.
In 2020, she married Isaac Arthur, and the couple are homeschooling their three young children and operate SFIA Enterprises and Badger Run Berries.
